findings.reason: the gate cannot show the Deliverable's stated coverage holds, so the Codex half of the requirement is unimplementable-on-pass and would be silently dropped.
findings.text: the Deliverable requires the list to cover "every variable that `dispatch_accounting._coordinator_runtime` … consult", which by that function's own body is `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`, `CODEX_SESSION_ID`, `CODEX_THREAD_ID` and `CLAUDE_PID`, yet the done-when (a) sets only the four `CLAUDE*` names and its negative control re-runs only those, so a builder can ship a Claude-only list and close the section while a producer under a Codex session keeps its identity

findings.reason: a node reading the constant satisfies "one setting, read in one place" yet diverges from the pane's actual window whenever flight config overrides it, so a stale margin is dropped where the pane would still show it.
findings.text: §50's Deliverable says the stale threshold "is the one the history replay already uses: one setting, read in one place", but the pane's history window is resolved per project by `_follow_history_caps` from flight config `ticker.history_window` (`reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2557`), falling back to the `DEFAULT_HISTORY_SECONDS` constant, and the plan names no reader
